text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On my day off, I see Satono Diamond
and Mejiro
McQueen together at a cafe.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Hello!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. McQueen brought me along to
one of her
favorite cafes today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Order anything that tickles your fancy.
Everything
on the menu is just exquisite.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!
Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Wow! This place has 129 different
desserts!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...And what's this? "Anyone who
conquers the
entire menu will receive a
special honor!" What
does that mean?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
W-well... this is only hearsay, but
apparently,
anyone who eats everything
on the menu is
granted the title of
"maestro."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Although, it appears that no one has
actually laid
claim to the title so far...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Indeed!
No one other than the (currently
slenderizing)
McQueen, that is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
How did you know that?! And why are
you here in
the first place?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
A title only McQueen has obtained? My
interest
has definitely been piqued now!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want to take on this challenge! I'll start
with the
first twenty or so items on the
left side of the
menu!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want to take on this challenge! I'll start
with the
first twenty or so items on the
left side of the
menu!
choice_data_list: カロリーオーバーだよ
choice_data_list_en: Want to give it a shot?
Want to give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That is a valid point... Hm, I guess I
should give
up on the idea...
choice_data_list: カロリーオーバーだよ
choice_data_list_en: Want to give it a shot?
Want to give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A sensible decision. After spending a
brutal,
ten-day long struggle to conquer
the challenge, I
wasn't in the best
shape...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ahem. In any case, desserts should be
eaten in
moderation. Now let's just
choose something we
like...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I recommend the katsudon, pickled
cucumbers,
and clam soup.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the advice. Then, I'll have
tho—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Those aren't even on the menu! Go
home already,
Gold Ship!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After considering her calorie intake,
Satono
Diamond eventually orders a
dessert Mejiro
McQueen recommends to
her.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll show you that I can mirror
McQueen's
accomplishment!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... I-I think this is my limit... It's like
I'm being
suffocated by sugary aromas...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I guess I'm still not on your level yet,
McQueen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Of course not. It took me ten days to
complete
the challenge. Attempting to
eat twenty items in
one go is just...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I don't know. I'd say that was quite the
feat.
Aren't you glad you have a
successor now,
McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A successor?! Ohhh, my misstep has
negatively
influenced the next
generation!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond eats a huge number of
desserts.
Will she keep this up and go on
to become the
second maestro?
